# Dataset Playback Fixture

dataset-still-test.mp4 is a 45-second loop of one existing thermal dataset frame:
光伏红外巡检数据集YOLO数据集/datasets/val/images/840.jpg.
The frame is encoded as H.264 at 640px width, 10 fps. It is not a flight recording,
not drone telemetry and not evidence of temporal defect persistence.
The UI explicitly labels this source as a dataset still-frame loop.
No generative imagery or synthetic thermal measurements were added.
